ayahs.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]
ayahs.e2: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled
ayahs.e2: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast

ayahs.en: Working [hard] and exhausted
ayahs.e2: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted

ayahs.en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire
ayahs.e2: burning in a scorching Fire

ayahs.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring
ayahs.e2: left to drink from a scalding spring

ayahs.ar: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعࣲ
ayahs.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ayahs.e2: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub
ayahs.tr: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree

ayahs.ar: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعࣲ
ayahs.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger
ayahs.e2: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger
ayahs.tr: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo

ayahs.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure
ayahs.e2: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss

ayahs.en: With their effort [they are] satisfied
ayahs.e2: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving

ayahs.en: In an elevated garden
ayahs.e2: in an elevated Garden

ayahs.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech
ayahs.e2: where no idle talk will be heard

ayahs.en: Within it is a flowing spring
ayahs.e2: In it will be a running spring

ayahs.en: Within it are couches raised high
ayahs.e2: along with thrones raised high

ayahs.en: And cups put in place
ayahs.e2: and cups set at hand

ayahs.en: And cushions lined up
ayahs.e2: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up

ayahs.en: And carpets spread around
ayahs.e2: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
ayahs.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created
ayahs.e2: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created

ayahs.en: And at the sky - how it is raised
ayahs.e2: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺

ayahs.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected
ayahs.e2: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up

ayahs.en: And at the earth - how it is spread out
ayahs.e2: and the earth—how it was levelled out

ayahs.en: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder
ayahs.e2: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind

ayahs.en: You are not over them a controller
ayahs.e2: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺

ayahs.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
ayahs.e2: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief

ayahs.en: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment
ayahs.e2: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment

ayahs.en: Indeed, to Us is their return
ayahs.e2: Surely to Us is their return

ayahs.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account
ayahs.e2: then surely with Us is their reckoning
